title: Al-Inshiqaq 84:21-25 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Inshiqaq and the sifat of strength
source: Written for quran/y6 lesson 16 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Inshiqaq 84:21-25 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 16. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩ (٢١) بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ (٢٢) وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ (٢٣) فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ (٢٤) إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ (٢٥)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]?
But those who have disbelieved deny,
And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
So give them tidings of a painful punishment,
Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.

keywords.def: cut off; 'ghayru mamnun' means never ending

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Inshiqaq 84:21-25 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 84:21-25 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 84:21-25 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Write who is excepted in 84:25 and what they receive.
questions.a: Those who believe and do righteous deeds: a reward never ending.

questions.q: Recite all 25 ayat to a partner and stop at the ۩.
questions.a: All 25 ayat; the pupil points out the sajdah at 84:21.

questions.q: What does the sign ۩ at 84:21 show?
questions.a: A) A place of prostration (sajdah). ۩ marks a sajdah of recitation. The surah ends at 84:25; stopping signs look different.

questions.q: Al-Inshiqaq 84:23: «وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: When the Qur'an is recited, what should a believer's heart and body do?
questions.a: Listen and humble themselves; 84:21 blames those who do not prostrate when the Qur'an is recited. There is a sajdah here.
